title: Count the path cells
prompt: Implement `countOnPath(int[][] g)`: count cells whose value is 1 that lie in **row 0**, in the **last column**, or on the **main diagonal** (cells where row == col). A cell satisfying several conditions still counts once.

tests.name: overlap counted once
tests.hint: check each cell once in one pass; a condition chain with else avoids double counting.
